mapper.select: select i.id, i.student_id, i.title, i.status, i.teacher_note, i.review_at, s.name as student_name from intervention_plan i join student s on s.id = i.student_id join class_room c on c.id = s.class_id where c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} order by i.updated_at desc limit 200

select i.id, i.student_id, i.warning_id, i.title, i.status, i.teacher_note, i.review_at, i.created_at, i.suggestions_json, s.name as student_name from intervention_plan i join student s on s.id = i.student_id where i.id = #{planId}
select id, action, status, occurred_on, result, created_by from intervention_record where plan_id = #{planId} order by id
select count(*) > 0 from warning_record where id = #{warningId} and student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: insert into intervention_plan(student_id, warning_id, title, status, suggestions_json, teacher_note, review_at, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{warningId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{suggestionsJson}, #{teacherNote}, #{reviewAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update intervention_plan set title = coalesce(#{title}, title), teacher_note = coalesce(#{teacherNote}, teacher_note), review_at = coalesce(#{reviewAt}, review_at) where id = #{planId}
update intervention_plan set status = #{status} where id = #{planId}
update intervention_plan set review_at = #{reviewAt}, teacher_note = coalesce(#{teacherNote}, teacher_note) where id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: insert into intervention_record(plan_id, action, status, occurred_on, result, created_by) values (#{planId}, #{action}, #{status}, #{occurredOn}, #{result}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update intervention_plan set status = #{inProgress} where id = #{planId} and status = #{confirmed}
